{
  "architecture_overview": "The mobile banking API is built using FastAPI with Python, structured in a layered architecture including API layer, service layer, and data access layer. JWT authentication secures endpoints, and rate limiting is enforced using middleware. OpenAPI 3.0 documentation is auto-generated by FastAPI. Each microservice endpoint is stateless, interacting with a PostgreSQL database for accounts, transactions, and payments. Redis is used for rate limiting and caching. Centralized error handling ensures standardized JSON responses across endpoints.",
  "technology_stack": ["FastAPI", "Python", "PostgreSQL", "Redis", "SQLAlchemy", "Pydantic", "JWT"],
  "api_endpoints": [
    {
      "method": "GET",
      "path": "/api/v1/balance",
      "description": "Retrieve current account balance for authenticated user",
      "request_body": null,
      "response": "{ 'account_id': 'string', 'balance': 'decimal', 'currency': 'string', 'timestamp': 'datetime' }"
    },
    {
      "method": "GET",
      "path": "/api/v1/transactions",
      "description": "Retrieve transaction history with optional date range filters",
      "request_body": "{ 'start_date': 'yyyy-mm-dd', 'end_date': 'yyyy-mm-dd', 'page': 'int', 'limit': 'int' }",
      "response": "{ 'transactions': [{'id': 'string', 'date': 'datetime', 'amount': 'decimal', 'type': 'string', 'description': 'string'}], 'pagination': {'total': 'int', 'page': 'int', 'limit': 'int'} }"
    },
    {
      "method": "POST",
      "path": "/api/v1/transfer",
      "description": "Transfer funds from one account to another securely",
      "request_body": "{ 'source_account_id': 'string', 'destination_account_id': 'string', 'amount': 'decimal', 'currency': 'string', 'note': 'string' }",
      "response": "{ 'transaction_id': 'string', 'status': 'string', 'message': 'string', 'timestamp': 'datetime' }"
    },
    {
      "method": "POST",
      "path": "/api/v1/bills/pay",
      "description": "Pay a utility bill using stored accounts",
      "request_body": "{ 'account_id': 'string', 'biller_id': 'string', 'amount': 'decimal', 'reference_number': 'string' }",
      "response": "{ 'payment_id': 'string', 'status': 'string', 'confirmation': 'string', 'timestamp': 'datetime' }"
    },
    {
      "method": "POST",
      "path": "/api/v1/auth/token",
      "description": "Authenticate user and return JWT token",
      "request_body": "{ 'username': 'string', 'password': 'string' }",
      "response": "{ 'access_token': 'string', 'token_type': 'Bearer', 'expires_in': 'int' }"
    }
  ],
  "database_schema": "CREATE TABLE users (id UUID PRIMARY KEY, username VARCHAR(150) UNIQUE, password_hash VARCHAR(255), created_at TIMESTAMP);\nCREATE TABLE accounts (id UUID PRIMARY KEY, user_id UUID REFERENCES users(id), balance NUMERIC(15,2), currency VARCHAR(3), updated_at TIMESTAMP);\nCREATE TABLE transactions (id UUID PRIMARY KEY, account_id UUID REFERENCES accounts(id), type VARCHAR(50), amount NUMERIC(15,2), description TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMP);\nCREATE TABLE bill_payments (id UUID PRIMARY KEY, account_id UUID REFERENCES accounts(id), biller_id VARCHAR(100), amount NUMERIC(15,2), reference_number VARCHAR(100), status VARCHAR(20), paid_at TIMESTAMP);",
  "security_considerations": [
    "All endpoints use HTTPS with TLS 1.2+",
    "JWT tokens include expiration and are validated on every request",
    "Rate limiting enforced via Redis-backed middleware per IP and user ID",
    "Sensitive data (passwords, tokens) stored encrypted using bcrypt and environment secrets",
    "Role-based access control for transaction and admin operations",
    "Audit logging implemented for fund transfers and bill payments"
  ],
  "code_structure": "app/\n  ├── main.py\n  ├── api/\n  │   ├── v1/\n  │   │   ├── balance.py\n  │   │   ├── transactions.py\n  │   │   ├── transfer.py\n  │   │   ├── bills.py\n  │   │   ├── auth.py\n  ├── core/\n  │   ├── config.py\n  │   ├── security.py\n  │   ├── rate_limit.py\n  │   ├── error_handlers.py\n  ├── db/\n  │   ├── models.py\n  │   ├── session.py\n  ├── services/\n  │   ├── balance_service.py\n  │   ├── transaction_service.py\n  │   ├── transfer_service.py\n  │   ├── bill_service.py\n  ├── schemas/\n  │   ├── balance_schema.py\n  │   ├── transaction_schema.py\n  │   ├── transfer_schema.py\n  │   ├── bill_schema.py\n  │   ├── auth_schema.py",
  "implementation_notes": "Use FastAPI dependency injection for authentication and DB sessions. Employ Pydantic for request and response validation. JWT tokens generated using PyJWT, stored securely with expiry claims. Rate limiting via Redis with configurable limits by endpoint. Error handling implemented through custom HTTPException handlers returning structured JSON messages. OpenAPI 3.0 documentation auto-generated through FastAPI and enriched with tags and examples. Automated unit tests and integration tests set up using pytest. Continuous integration pipeline ensures schema compliance and security checks."
}
